item.title: Suzuki Philippines Secures Historic 3rd Place In Full-Year 2025 Sales
item.description: Suzuki Philippines has achieved its highest sales ranking ever in its corporate history by securing third place based on the official data released by the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines (CAMPI).Read More »

item.title: In Time For Its 20th Year Anniversary, UAAGI Opens Massive Technical Center And Parts Hub In Valenzuela
item.description: UAAGI Auto Group has officially inaugurated the UAAGI Center for Technical Excellence in Valenzuela, a move that solidifies its 20-year legacy of expertise and commitment to reliable aftersales service in the Philippine automotive industry.Read More »

item.title: The Chery Tiggo 2 Pro Is Now Known As The Tiggo Touring
item.description: Chery Auto Philippines continues to move away from its numeric nomenclature, at least for the Philippine market. After the launch of the Tiggo Cross (formerly Tiggo 5x), Tiggo Grand Tour (formerly the Tiggo 8), and the Tiggo rEV C-DM (known globally as the Tiggo 9), the automaker has now re-branded the Tiggo 2 Pro as the Tiggo Touring for 2026.Read More »

item.title: Opus Mall Is Tesla's Newest Supercharging Location
item.description: Tesla Philippines will open its newest Supercharging location, this time at the Opus Mall in Bridgetowne, Quezon City. Once activated, the Supercharger will be located at the mall’s Level 3 – Mezzanine Parking.Read More »

item.title: Isuzu Dominates Philippine Truck Segment With 42.2 Percent Market Share In 2025
item.description: Isuzu Philippines Corporation (IPC) once again affirmed its leadership in the local commercial vehicle industry after retaining its position as the country’s No. 1 truck brand for the 26th consecutive year, highlighting its long-standing commitment to supporting Filipino businesses with durable products, dependable service, and total business solutions.Read More »

item.title: This Solar-Powered Nissan Ariya EV May Not Require Any Recharging At All
item.description: Nissan may have developed a vehicle that may not require any refueling or recharging at all. The solution is ingenious, and at the same time, simple: add solar panels on the Ariya EV.Read More »

item.title: MG Dumaguete Is Now Open
item.description: MG Motor Philippines and Gateway Group officially inaugurated the MG Dumaguete Showroom, marking another step in the brand’s continued expansion in the Visayas region.Read More »

item.title: Green GSM Is Now Equipping Its EV Taxis With Tech-Based Secure-To-Safe System
item.description: All-electric taxi company, Green GSM, is leveraging technology to keep its drivers and passengers safe. The company has begun rolling out its Secure-to-Safe (S2S) system which is standard across the entire fleet. And compared to other methods, S2S is designed as a coordinated safety support system that combines technology, procedures, and human response.Read More »

item.title: Jing Atienza Is The New CAMPI President
item.description: The Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc. (CAMPI) enters a new era as Jose Maria “Jing” Atienza officially takes over as President of the automotive industry association. He takes over the reigns from Rommel Gutierrez who steps down after a 14-year stint.Read More »

item.title: Chevrolet Extends "The Gift Of Great Service" With Out-Of-Warranty Change Oil Change
item.description: Chevrolet Philippines, through its official distributor Hariphil Asia Resources, Inc. (HARI), kicks off the year by extending “The Gift of Great Service”— an exclusive Out-of-Warranty Change Oil Package Promo designed to give Chevrolet owners added peace of mind on the road.Read More »
